note.CH: A package of services is taxed at the normal rate; a bare letting of rooms is exempt (art. 21 MWSTG) unless you opted (art. 22): say which on the legal identity. The 3.8 % special rate applies to accommodation only. If the vote of 29 November 2026 passes, 8.5 % and 4.0 % apply from 2028: change them by law then.
note.GB: A bare desk or office licence is exempt (VAT Act 1994 Sch 9 Group 1) unless you opted to tax the building; a serviced package of facilities is standard-rated. Keep the lines that apply.
note.US: The US has no federal VAT — sales tax is set by state and locality. Add your local combined rate manually.
